listing.name: Astartes Minipack
listing.summary: Adds a Space Marine Battle Barge and a few hand-painted player portraits.

description:
Adds a Space Marine Battle Barge and a few hand-painted player portraits.

The Battle Barge is a 50dp Low Tech capital ship which comes in two versions, with various paintjobs available for different chapters of the Adeptus Astartes. It can be obtained from the Hegemony and the Luddic Church.

**MagicLib** is required for the paintjobs, everything else will work without it.


**Download**:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ANiXX8vidc9fZZAhuo2cMJk2tk-ZtnTd/view?usp=sharing

*And they shall know no fear.*
